usage.outputShape: body.images[0].url (1024x1024 JPG); also body.images[0].width, body.images[0].height, body.seed, body.model, body.inference_time_ms
usage.guide: POST a JSON body {"prompt":"<your image description>"} to the endpoint with x402 payment ($0.015 USDC on Base). Response is synchronous JSON; read the generated image URL from body.images[0].url (a hosted fal.media JPG, 1024x1024). No auth, no polling, no template params.
